name: tune-idle-compact
note: G2 (ui-ux-polish 2026-10-08): the Tune card's IDLE state (before Start, and what Stop returns to) must not reserve the live readout's room or show a bare middle dot. Before: a 540px card with ~110px blank above the chips, ~115px below Start, a middle dot in the big-note slot, and a runway with no target. After: the card hugs its content (<330px), the runway waits for Start, the big-note slot names the first string (free mode: the whole sequence), Start stays a 44px+ primary button above 60% of the viewport, and the string row stays above the fold. Live phases keep their exact geometry (checked by the before/after JSON in docs/artifacts/ui-polish-20261008). Headless Chromium has no microphone, so the live leg drives Tuner._sim (same flow + render path as tune-guided).

steps.label: idle: Start is a 44px+ button whose top sits at or above 60% of the viewport
idle: the string buttons row ends above the fold
idle: the big-note slot is a real note name, never a lone middle dot
idle: the card reserves no live readout rows (card under 330px, no runway)
idle: Guided / Any string chips and the Tone toggle are still there
live: Start leaves idle - runway shows, card regains its full height
idle again: Stop returns to the compact idle card with a real note
